purpose: Quantify empirical forecast allowances and distinguish them from downstream task requirements.
metric: Physical vector error for velocity/body rate, accelerometer/gyro in sensor case. Rotation-entry group reported separately, not angular error.
statistics: nearest-rank empirical 95th percentile of endpoint error
nearest-rank empirical 95th percentile of maximum error anywhere through the horizon
per-recording and minimum-across-recordings simultaneous observed fraction within illustrative limits
limits_interpretation: Illustrative forecast requirements, not derived task tolerances or recommended flight limits. No fit/selection/adoption uses them.
control_reasoning: Analytical scalar error-feedback example: same residual RMS, different temporal structure and contraction; no vehicle controller changes.
evidence: All saved evaluation recordings previously inspected; windows overlap; empirical fractions and percentiles are descriptive, not calibrated probabilities. No new closed-loop trial or hardware validation.
